contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime East Asian urban shopping streets with small tiled building walls, cafe and florist shopfronts, canvas awnings, utility pipes and stone paving; no rain depicted and reflective paving is not read as rain; humidity not inferred. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The receipt stuck to the raised flat and the paper grocery bag with greens are scene props, not products. The slate collarless jacket is shown closed on a turned body, so its far side and back are conservatively reconstructed; the ivory tee hem and neckline are visible and its back is inferred. No socks are visible, so none are listed. Only one silver-tone hoop is visible; the pair is inferred. Brand, metal, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

copy.titleEn: A SMALL PAPER AT THE TOE

title.en: A small paper at the toe

deck.ko: 칼라 없는 회색 재킷과 검정 플랫의 간결한 선.
deck.en: A collarless gray jacket meets a clean black flat.
deck.de: Kragenloses Grau trifft auf einen schlichten schwarzen Ballerina.

intro.ko: 신발에 붙은 영수증을 보고 한쪽 발을 들며 몸이 옆으로 돌아갑니다.
intro.en: Spotting a receipt stuck to the shoe, she lifts one foot and turns to look.
intro.de: Beim Entdecken des angehafteten Kassenbons hebt sie einen Fuß und dreht sich um.

body.ko: 슬레이트 재킷의 둥근 목선 아래 아이보리 티가 조금 드러납니다. 짧은 검정 바지는 발목을 남기고 작은 리본의 발레 플랫으로 이어집니다. 귀 옆의 얇은 은색 링은 단정한 단발과 함께 가벼운 마무리가 됩니다. 흐린 낮의 직광 플래시는 회색 재킷의 봉제선과 발을 올린 순간의 주름을 분명하게 보여줍니다.
body.en: A little ivory tee shows beneath the slate jacket neckline. Cropped black trousers leave an ankle interval before bow-front ballet flats. Fine silver hoops finish the chin-length bob lightly. Daytime direct flash makes the gray seams and the folds of the raised leg clear against the tiled storefront.
body.de: Etwas elfenbeinfarbenes Shirt zeigt sich unter dem schiefergrauen Jackenausschnitt. Die verkürzte schwarze Hose lässt Abstand am Knöchel vor Ballerinas mit Schleifen. Feine silberfarbene Creolen ergänzen den kinnlangen Bob. Direkter Tagesblitz zeichnet graue Nähte und die Falten des angehobenen Beins vor der gefliesten Ladenfront klar.

pull.en: A cropped hem leaves room at the ankle.
pull.de: Ein kurzer Saum lässt Platz am Knöchel.

copy.pullQuoteEn: A cropped hem leaves room at the ankle.

tip.ko: 움직이기 전에 밑창의 종이를 제거하고 티 밑단을 가볍게 정리하세요.
tip.en: Remove the paper before walking and lightly straighten the tee hem.
tip.de: Das Papier vor dem Weitergehen entfernen und den Shirtsaum leicht glätten.

description.ko: 둥근 목선과 어두운 단추, 웰트 포켓의 짧은 회색 재킷입니다.
description.en: Short gray jacket with round neckline, dark buttons and welt pockets.
description.de: Kurze graue Jacke mit Rundhals, dunklen Knöpfen und Leistentaschen.

howToWear.ko: 아이보리 티의 목선이 일정하게 보이도록 앞을 열어 주세요.
howToWear.en: Open the front for an even ivory line at the neckline.
howToWear.de: Vorn öffnen und am Ausschnitt eine gleichmäßige elfenbeinfarbene Linie zeigen.
